entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appel
 Through: Mr. A.K. Soni & Mr. Pavan Kumar,
 Advocates.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order
1 .  The present appeal preferred by the insurer seeks to assail the award dated 28.09.2022 passed by learned MACT.

Vide the impugned award, the learned Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.
19,83,000/- to the respondent with interest @ 9% per annum.

2. By placing reliance on the decision dated 06.05.2009 of the Apex Court in this "National Insurance Company Ltd. Vs. Hamida Khatoon & Ors", Civil Appeal No. 3324/2009, decided on 06.05.2009, learned counsel for the appellant submits that once the respondents have received compensation for the same accident under the Employees' State Insurance Act, they were barred from making any claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Ltd. Vs. Hamida Khatoon & Ors", Civil Appeal No. 3324/2009
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
Reply, if any, to the application be filed within six weeks.
Rejoinder thereto be filed within four weeks thereafter.
4. Subject to the appellant depositing, within eight weeks, 70% of the awarded amount, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed till the next date of hearing.

5. List on 04.05.2023.
REKHA PALLI, J JANUARY 18, 2023(mr)
